title: Aššur-bêl-kala
description: Ruler of Assyria. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-14 (Table 5, "CFAH Reconstructed Eponym List (CFAH-REL)"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Column: Assyrian King List; Name row (Year BC): 1073; Last regnal-year row (Year BC): 1056 (year 18)). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.date: Column: Assyrian King List; Name row (Year BC): 1073; Last regnal-year row (Year BC): 1056 (year 18)
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-14: Ancient Assyria," OSF preprint v1.0 (27 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/9FUW2, file CFAH-14_Assyria_v_1.0.pdf, Table 5 "CFAH Reconstructed Eponym List (CFAH-REL)", pp. 62–64
reign.note: Row "Aššur-bêl-kala" of Table 5 (Assyria). Year-by-year table (1262-963 BC). A ruler's name is printed in one year row and his regnal-year numbers in the following rows; each row here gives the Year BC of the name row and of the last numbered row, as printed. No year is computed from a length.
